name: Production Mix Allocation
context: Allocate a fixed plant capacity across products on three lines to maximize unit margin, throughput, and sustainability. No single product may take more than 30% of capacity, and each line can run at most two SKUs at once (a changeover/tooling limit). Three purely linear objectives over a continuous allocation make this an exact multi-objective LP — so beyond the frontier the solver returns exact duals: which line is the binding constraint to expand (shadow price), which product is the closest near-miss (reduced cost), and which SKU is the fractional swing that sets the marginal price (basic at ~0).
